units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 75:9">Targ. Ps. LXXV, 9</cite> <he>דורדייהא ופקטייהא</he> (ed. Wil. <he>ופִקְטְיָהָא</he>; h. text <he>שמריה</he>).—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b:12">B. Mets. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>פִּקְטָךְ מאי איעביד להו</he> (sing. form) it is thy froth (of the oil which thou hast deposited with me), what has been done with it? (it is not my fault; Ms. O. <he>מאי אעביד לך</he> what can I do for thee?).
